annotation.title_clean: 工业和信息化部等十二部门关于印发《5G规模化应用“扬帆”行动升级方案》的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of Twelve Departments including the MIIT on Issuing the Upgraded Action Plan for "Sailing" Large-Scale 5G Application
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 工业和信息化部等十二部门 (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and eleven other departments)
annotation.venue: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (China)
annotation.summary_en: Chinese 12-ministry action plan promoting large-scale 5G application through 2027, covering consumer, industrial and public-service sectors. It touches on 5G-enabled intelligent robots, autonomous driving, AGVs, drones, unmanned mining trucks and vessels, but mainly sets industrial-policy targets, standards and security measures for 5G.
key_provisions_or_claims: Targets by end-2027: 5G personal user penetration above 85%, 70,000 industry virtual private networks, 1,000+ innovative industry terminal modules.
Promotes 5G-enabled intelligent robots, vehicle 5G modules, platooning and remote driving, AGV/RGV logistics, unmanned mining trucks, unmanned vessels and agricultural drones.
Calls for 150+ 5G converged-application standards and faster 5G-A international standards.
Builds a 5G application security assurance system with 5+ security benchmarks and 30+ atomic security capabilities.
Support measures: ministerial coordination, spectrum supply, financing, talent training and monitoring.
